image_description: A close-up shot of a white plate containing two dessert items. On the left is a small, cylindrical chocolate cake or mousse topped with a thick, glossy layer of dark chocolate sauce that has a swirled texture on top. On the right is a smooth, pale yellow scoop of ice cream or sorbet. The lighting creates strong specular highlights on the chocolate surface.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Thick, glossy liquid condiment with deep brown to dark chocolate coloration.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The topping on the left dessert item is clearly dark brown/black and exhibits a high-gloss finish consistent with chocolate sauce.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Smooth, reflective sheen with viscous, syrupy consistency.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Strong specular highlights indicate a smooth, reflective surface. The way it coats the top of the cylinder suggests viscosity.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Forms ribbons that gradually level out when poured.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The image is static; the sauce is already settled on the dessert. There is no active pouring action visible to verify ribbon formation.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Uniform texture with no visible particulates.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The surface of the chocolate appears homogenous and smooth without visible chunks, nuts, or graininess.
Static image cannot demonstrate flow rate or viscosity dynamics over time.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Surface tension creates slight meniscus at container edges.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The chocolate sauce conforms tightly to the circular edge of the cake top, showing cohesive behavior typical of surface tension in viscous liquids.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Color ranges from rich mahogany to near-black depending on cocoa concentration.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The color is a very deep brown, bordering on black in shadowed areas, fitting the description.
Distinct white reflections from the light source are visible on the chocolate surface.
Contextually placed on a cake-like item alongside ice cream, confirming its role as a dessert condiment.

artifact_observations.location: Top surface of the chocolate cake
artifact_observations.reasoning: The swirl pattern on the top of the chocolate sauce looks slightly 'painted' or digitally smoothed rather than naturally formed by a spatula or pour. The transition between the highlight and the dark chocolate is somewhat abrupt.

The vertical side of the chocolate cylinder has a jagged, irregular texture that doesn't quite look like cake crumbs or a mold seam. It appears slightly melted or structurally undefined where it meets the plate.
The ice cream scoop is perfectly spherical but lacks the subtle melting or gravity-induced flattening usually seen in real ice cream, giving it a slightly plastic or CGI appearance.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the specific material classification of the glossy topping versus the cake base.
To evaluate the overall realism, lighting consistency, and detect subtle generative artifacts in textures.
To check for edge bleeding between the sauce and the cake/plate, ensuring distinct physical separation.
To verify the spatial relationship and contact shadows between the desserts and the plate surface.

focus_areas: Texture realism of the chocolate sauce (specular highlights vs. surface detail)
Boundary integrity between the sauce and the cake body
Physical plausibility of the ice cream scoop shape
Contact shadows and grounding of objects on the plate
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the 'swirl' pattern on the chocolate. In AI images, these often look like noise or unnatural gradients rather than physical ridges. Also, inspect the junction where the vertical side of the chocolate cake meets the plate; AI often struggles with this contact point, resulting in blurring or floating effects. Verify if the ice cream scoop has any surface porosity or if it is unnaturally smooth.
